verdict.rationale: No first-party evidence shows that Antigravity lets a developer sign in with an existing subscription plan to use the coding agent; the docs cover agents, CLI, SDK and settings but never subscription-based sign-in. The only related item is a community report that an active Google AI Pro subscription did not grant Antigravity access without a separate 'Antigravity entitlement'. Without a documented vendor capability, that report cannot establish delivery or a dispute.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent
